job.title: Maintenance Mechanic
job.description:
Maintenance Mechanic Full-Time | Ongoing Opportunity | Marine & Structural Maintenance

Foundation Labour Hire is currently seeking an experienced Maintenance Mechanic to join a busy marine structures operation. This is an excellent opportunity for a mechanically skilled tradesperson who enjoys hands-on maintenance, fault finding, repairs and working around marine infrastructure.

You will play a key role in keeping machinery, equipment and facilities operating safely and efficiently, with a strong focus on preventative maintenance, breakdown response and continuous improvement.

Working closely with the Maintenance Supervisor and broader maintenance team, you will be responsible for maintaining and repairing a range of machinery and equipment used in pontoon, jetty and marine structure construction.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Conduct scheduled preventative maintenance on machinery, plant and equipment.
  • Inspect, clean, lubricate and adjust mechanical components to maintain optimal performance.
  • Diagnose mechanical faults and identify the root cause of equipment failures.
  • Carry out mechanical repairs, component replacement and equipment servicing.
  • Respond to breakdowns and emergency maintenance requirements to minimise downtime.
  • Undertake basic welding, fabrication and machining as required.
  • Read and interpret technical manuals, drawings and equipment specifications.
  • Identify worn, damaged or defective components and recommend appropriate repairs.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, service reports and parts usage documentation.
  • Work closely with the Maintenance Supervisor to communicate equipment condition, faults and repair requirements.
  • Follow established marine industry procedures, workplace health and safety requirements and maintenance standards.
  • Identify and report potential hazards, equipment defects and safety issues.
  • Assist with continuous improvement initiatives to improve equipment reliability and reduce downtime.
  • Support and mentor junior maintenance personnel where required.
  • Maintain a clean, organised and safe workshop and work environment.
  • Ensure tools and equipment are returned to their designated locations at the completion of each shift.
You will be a practical and mechanically minded tradesperson with strong fault-finding skills and the ability to work independently while contributing to a broader maintenance team.

Ideally, you will have:
  • Certificate III in Engineering – Mechanical Trade, Mechanical Fitting or equivalent experience.
  • Proven experience in a mechanical maintenance role, preferably within marine, construction, manufacturing, heavy industry or a similar environment.
  • Experience working with marine structures, pontoons, jetties or related equipment will be highly regarded.
  • Basic welding and fabrication capabilities.
  • Strong mechanical troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, drawings and specifications.
  • Strong understanding of preventative and reactive maintenance practices.
  • High level of attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
  • Strong safety awareness and understanding of workplace safety procedures.
  • Ability to undertake physically demanding work and operate effectively in heat, rain and varied outdoor conditions.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.
  • A proactive approach to identifying problems and finding practical solutions.
What’s on Offer?
  • Long-term, ongoing employment opportunity
  • Work within the marine structures industry
  • Variety of mechanical maintenance and repair work
  • Supportive maintenance team
  • Opportunity to develop your skills across mechanical, fabrication and marine equipment
  • Potential for career progression for the right person
Apply Now If you're a qualified Maintenance Mechanic looking for a stable, hands-on opportunity and have experience keeping machinery and equipment operating reliably, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: All-Round Operators & Civil Labourers
job.description:
We’re recruiting experienced All-Round Plant Operators and Civil Labourers for an 8–12 week pavement upgrade project in Roma, commencing in late August.

The project will involve pavement construction, trimming, compaction, haulage and general earthworks. We’re looking for reliable people who understand civil construction, can work safely within a mixed crew and are comfortable meeting daily production targets.

Above-Award rates and penalties apply, with consistent hours and potential ongoing opportunities for high performers.

All-Round Plant Operators will support all stages of the pavement program, including bulk earthworks, trimming, compaction, water management and general site activities.

Key responsibilities:
  • Operating multiple machines to support pavement construction
  • Roller operation for compaction and final trim
  • Watercart operation for dust suppression and moisture conditioning
  • Excavator operation for trimming, loading and general earthworks
  • Assisting ground crews when required
  • Completing daily pre-starts, basic maintenance checks and safety documentation
  • Meeting production targets while maintaining safe work practices
Required tickets and experience:
  • Roller ticket – essential
  • HR licence – essential
  • Demonstrated watercart experience
  • Excavator ticket – essential
  • Previous civil construction experience, ideally on pavement projects
  • Ability to work within a structured safety environment
  • Loader, skid steer, grader or dozer tickets are highly regarded
What’s on Offer
  • Above-Award hourly rates plus applicable penalties
  • 8–12 weeks of consistent work
  • Monday-to-Friday roster, with potential Saturday work depending on the program
  • Weekly pay
  • Supportive supervisors and a well-structured site
  • Fast onboarding for experienced, appropriately ticketed candidates
  • FIFO from Brisbane available for suitably qualified candidates
  • Potential ongoing work on future projects
Who We’re Looking For
We want people who turn up, work hard and communicate well. Operators must be willing to move between machines and support the wider crew when required. Labourers must be hands-on, safety-focused and ready to contribute.

Applicants must be available to commence in late August and commit to the full project duration.

job.title: Senior Electrical Estimator - Sunshine Coast
job.description:
Join a company built on trust, reliability, and long-standing relationships.
Our client is proud to be one of Queensland's most respected electrical contracting businesses, delivering high-quality electrical, data, and communication solutions across a diverse range of projects. From commercial and industrial developments to critical infrastructure and community facilities they install, and maintain the systems that keep homes, businesses, and communities connected and powered.
As their project portfolio continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced Senior Estimator to join their team and play a key role in securing and delivering the next generation of projects across Queensland.
 
About the Role
Reporting directly to the Estimating Manager, the Senior Estimator will be responsible for preparing accurate and competitive tenders for a wide range of electrical projects. This is a strategic role requiring strong commercial acumen, technical expertise, and the ability to build positive relationships with clients, consultants, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
You will lead the estimating process from initial enquiry through to tender submission, ensuring all opportunities are assessed effectively and align with the company's growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities
  • Review tender documentation, specifications, drawings, and contract requirements.
  • Conduct quantity take-offs and develop pricing strategies.
  • Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations.
  • Identify project risks and opportunities during tender review.
  • Develop tender submissions and supporting documentation.
  • Participate in client meetings, clarification processes, and negotiations.
  • Maintain and improve estimating systems, databases, and procedures.
  • Work closely with project delivery teams to ensure successful project handover.
  • Mentor and support junior estimating staff where required.
About You To be successful in this role, you will bring:
  • Proven experience in an Electrical Estimator or Senior Estimator position.
  • Possess an Electrical trade qualification and/or engineering background.
  • Strong understanding of commercial, industrial, and infrastructure electrical projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tenders simultaneously.
  • Excellent knowledge of electrical systems, installation methodologies, and industry standards.
  • High-level proficiency in estimating software and the Microsoft Office suite.
  • Strong analytical, commercial, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • A proactive and collaborative approach with strong attention to detail.
  • Experience working within a Tier 1, Tier 2, or large-scale electrical contracting environment.
  • Knowledge of Queensland market conditions, suppliers, and subcontractors.
The rewards for the successful candidate:
  • A secure position within a well-established and growing Queensland business.
  • A strong pipeline of diverse and challenging projects.
  • Competitive salary package - Very solid base salary & super, + vehicle + bonus !
  • Supportive leadership team and collaborative culture.
  • Opportunities for career development and progression.
  • A workplace where your expertise is valued and your contributions make a genuine impact.
Apply Now If you're a driven and experienced estimator looking to take the next step in your career with a company that values integrity, quality, and long-term partnerships, we'd love to hear from you.
Contact Paul Gay for a confidential discussion on 0415379586 or simply follow the prompts to submit your details.
